findings.suggested_fix: Recognize and remove only the expected transport-generated heartbeat comments from the complete bounded stream before strict validation and before returning to the broker; add an actual-handler fixture that pauses long enough for a heartbeat and verifies normalized success.
findings.title: Handle Bifrost heartbeat comments without rejecting valid streams
findings.why_it_matters: The real Bifrost typed streaming handler emits a heartbeat comment every second while idle. The exchange rejects the comment after consuming the provider response, so otherwise healthy streams with a one-second idle gap cannot complete and may incur charges.

engine/transport/factory_gateway_exchange.go:345-357 treats each data line independently and sets done on [DONE] without requiring a following delimiter.

findings.suggested_fix: Parse bounded SSE as explicitly delimited events, require the permitted single data line in each event and the final blank delimiter, and add negative cases for adjacent data lines and a truncated terminal frame.
findings.title: Require complete SSE event framing before acknowledging success
findings.why_it_matters: The gateway accepts adjacent data lines and a terminal marker without a closing blank delimiter, then can seal capture and send HTTP 200 for malformed or truncated SSE. A stricter downstream broker may subsequently reject it, after the physical attempt is consumed.

residual_risks: The synthetic native join uses a fixture router, manual witness, authorizer and capture ACKs; it does not establish actual inference, durable wallet, provider bounds, or watchdog qualification.
The synchronous Router.Handler may block before a stream is created; dedicated watchdog and descendant cleanup qualification remains required.
Cancellation assumes Close returns; the current real typed handler uses nonblocking lib.SSEStreamReader.Close, but protected router/plugin configuration must preserve or bound this property.
testing_gaps: The synthetic native join does not exercise the actual inference handler through exchange or its real authentication/middleware and durable wallet closure.
